On the doorstep lay a coil of red hair, wet with salt, and a note: “Thank you.”","w02":"凌晨四点，城市把喧嚣折进深蓝色的影子。高架桥托着零星的灯，出租车滑过空旷路口，像迟归的逗号。环卫车转过街角，刷子唤醒潮湿的路面；风穿过广告牌，远处第一班地铁尚未进站。某扇窗忽然亮了，有人为婴儿温奶，有人合上电脑。天边泛出一线灰白，昨夜未说完的话，正悄悄等待清晨。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a big problem by solving a smaller version of the same problem.\n- You repeat this until you reach a tiny problem with an easy answer, called the base case.\n- Then the small answers combine to solve the big problem, like opening nested boxes until you find the prize."}
